description: List videos in a Vimeo channel — human-curated collections, the flagship being Vimeo Staff Picks (default channel). Any channel slug works (vimeo.com/channels/{channel}): sub-channels premieres, bestofstaffpicks, thedecade, or user-created channels such as music. Returns the channel profile (name, url, description, video/follower/moderator counts, owner, id) plus video cards with title, url, duration, author, views, likes, comments, thumbnail and description. sort=preset keeps the curator's ordering; other orders are date, alphabetical, plays, likes, duration. Paginates internally up to the limit (max 100, 12 per page); partial=true when the listing is exhausted. Public content, no login needed.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Channel slug from the channel URL: vimeo.com/channels/{channel} (default 'staffpicks' — Vimeo Staff Picks). Related picks: premieres, bestofstaffpicks, thedecade. Discovery: vimeo/search --type channel.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Listing order: preset (default, the curator's ordering) | date (newest) | alphabetical | plays (most viewed) | likes | duration.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum videos to return (1-100, default 20). The channel lists 12 per page; the command paginates internally, partial=true when exhausted.
